written.headline: US and allies agree to create joint list to protect AI supply chains from China
written.summary: The US and allies including Japan, the UK, and India agreed to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect from China. The accord comes ahead of Donald Trump's meeting with Xi Jinping at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen.

written.headline: Howard Lutnick pushed to narrow chip curbs affecting a former firm's client
written.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick pushed to narrow chip rules that would affect Southeast Asian data centers. Some of these data centers are clients of his former firm, Cantor Fitzgerald, and one may serve Tencent.

written.headline: Howard Lutnick joins Trump on Air Force One to China amid Nvidia chip curbs dispute
written.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is expected to travel on Air Force One with the president to China this week. The trip follows clashes with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and others over Nvidia chip curbs.

written.headline: Apple plans smart glasses launch in 2027 relying on Siri and iPhone apps
written.summary: Apple plans to unveil its first smart glasses at WWDC in June 2027 and ship them before the end of the year, according to a report by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The glasses will integrate third-party iPhone apps with Siri AI and feature cameras for Visual Intelligence.
